notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company building an in-app intelligence layer (summaries + semantic doc search + triage assistant). Evaluation started with Hosted API to accelerate dev; moving toward Dedicated for predictable latency/cost as usage grows.

Key asks / constraints:
- Latency target: p95 <= 250-350ms for chat flows; pages of doc-search allowed up to 500ms. Customer emphasized user experience slowness is the primary churn risk.
- Throughput: initial target 60-120 requests/sec across peak shards; plan to scale.
- Cost sensitivity: unit economics model required — goal: <$0.004 per end-user MAU request mix on steady state.
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-curated LLMs (smaller variants for summarization, larger for complex assistant); fallback policy to lower-cost variant during peak.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required now; contract must support SSO/SAML and audit_logging; KMS integration and data residency in us-east-1 for now.

Engagement timeline (bulleted CRM-style):
- 2026-02-28: Intro demo (hosted API) w/ AE (Sofia) + SE (Ethan). Fireflies: ff-20260302-amberfall-demo.
- 2026-03-04: PoC kickoff (hosted). Internal devs onboarded; early integration of chat + search endpoints.
- 2026-03-08: Cost optimization workshop w/ Redwood SE team. Topics: batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles (int8/int4), routing & fallback, reservation sizing for Dedicated. Fireflies: ff-20260308-cost-workshop.
- 2026-03-09: Workshop follow-up call; delivered quick-cost model and sample unit economics spreadsheet (drive link).

Workshop outcomes & PoC findings (technical + commercial):
- Batching: observed 2.2x token throughput lift with 16-request batching on non-chat bulk flows; reduces effective per-token compute cost significantly for embeddings/search.
- Prefix / KV caching: initial prototype hit-rates ~45% on doc search; expected >60% after cold-start warm-up and smart prefixing. Cache reduces repeated prompt token cost ~30-50% depending on dataset.
- Quantization experiments: ran int8 and 4-bit quantized variants for summarization model. Quality delta: ~2.5% drop on key ROUGE-ish proxy; PM willing to accept for non-critical summaries. Cost improvement estimated 1.9-3.5x depending on runtime.
- Unit economics: combined strategy (batching + caching + quantization) projects ~40-55% reduction in per-token cost vs Hosted baseline. Sample scenario: 10k DAU with mixed chat/search workload -> projected monthly inference cost reduced from ~$18k (hosted baseline) to ~$8.7k with Dedicated + optimizations (rough).
- Routing/fallback: recommending policy for low-latency critical flows to use dedicated low-latency pool and non-critical to use lower-cost variants; automatic fallback to hosted spare capacity in region for burst protection.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "Primary metric is perceived latency — users abandon slow replies." — PM (Elena Torres).
- "Willing to trade a little summary fidelity for 2-3x cost improvement on cheap flows." — Eng lead (Tom Okafor).

Security & legal steps in flight:
- Submitted SOC2 questionnaire 2026-03-05 (drive link).
- SIEM / audit log ingestion: partner security team requested ingestion doc + sample events.
- Data residency: must stay in us-east-1 for now; roadmap to add eu-west-1 in Q4.

Open risks / blockers (CRM tone):
- Procurement window: Procurement only approves vendor changes during monthly vendor review (next window 2026-04-15).
- Legal / Data retention: retention terms in our standard SOW must be adjusted; legal wants explicit data deletion SLA for short-term cache.
- Quantization quality acceptance: PM needs artifact-level audit (10k examples) to sign off; need to run extended quantized POC.

Next steps (short):
- AE to send Dedicated pricing + reserved capacity proposal by 2026-03-12 (Sofia).
- SE to schedule 3-week quantized POC (Ethan) — includes evaluation harness, quality metrics, and perf profile under Dedicated.
- Security pack (SOC2 evidence + audit events) to be compiled and shared to security@amberfall via Drive link.
- Follow-up call w/ procurement & legal (target 2026-03-18) to address contract tweaks.

Internal notes for Redwood team (one-liners):
- Good mid-market ARR potential if cost targets achievable.
- High chance to convert to Dedicated if quantized POC shows <5% quality delta and p95 latency <350ms.
- Prioritize delivery of unit-econ slides and dedicated reservation sizing for next AE touch.
